value.rationale: Dürer is a canonical cubic planar generalized Petersen graph, and complete basin-size multiplicities and the sharp transient histogram are natural exact dynamical invariants not captured by attractor counts. The result differentiates isolated polarized equilibria from huge consensus basins, identifies the exact 96 worst-delayed states, supplies a symmetry-resolved benchmark, and adds a nontrivial all-family symbolic isolation theorem.
